fichas.title: Position of the Sun
fichas.summary: Explains how solar position diagrams show the sun’s azimuth and elevation by date and time. Describes reading hourly and daily curves, using stereographic projections to trace the sun’s path, and converting solar time to local time. Examples are given for Brighton, UK, and Darmstadt, Germany.
uses: Assessing daylight conditions by time of day and date
Tracing the sun’s path for daylight and shading studies
Converting solar time to local time
